overview.description: The State Street SPDR S&P Global Infrastructure ETF (GII) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Global Infrastructure index, a market-cap-weighted index of 75 infrastructure companies from developed and emerging markets engaged in the energy, transportation, or utility sectors. GII was launched on Jan 25, 2007 and is issued by State Street.
